svg.title: Assembled - page 7
svg.text: A3 landscape — page 1 of 3 (sheet 7 of 9)
Section 3 of 3 - A3 landscape

Set to 420 x 297 mm, and the section after it is not. Look for the sheet changing size and orientation at the boundary rather than the whole file taking one size, for the footer counting twice - page n
of this section, sheet n of the file - and for nothing flowing across the boundary: what does not fit adds pages to its own section, which is what makes a table changing width mid-continuation
inexpressible rather than merely discouraged. This one also declares a limit of 1 page(s) and needs more. The layout reports that and refuses nothing - composing and drawing are two calls, so the
caller looks and then decides.
